title: THE WRAPPED WING
toast: WASD to walk. Shift to hurry. F wraps whatever you look at. Click anything. 1 to 8 jumps rooms. K to skate.
eggline: Every egg in the wing found. The museum has counted you. You are now a permanent collection.
hooks: POV: you broke into the museum and wrapped everything in paintings
the sphinx has three riddles and union rules
the guards only move when you look away
the audio guide is lying and it is so confident
the gift shop price goes up while you look
the moon is huge until you look up
one of the originals was never original
